comparison.toggleOpen: Show the full feature and limit breakdown

items.a: Yes, with no time limit. Unlimited projects, row counter, pattern library, technical details — without ever paying. Uploaded files (PDFs, images) are limited to 100 MB on FREE; patterns as URLs or text are unlimited. PLUS and PRO make sense once your projects grow.

items.q: What's the actual difference between FREE, PLUS and PRO?
items.a: FREE covers everyday use: counting rows, recording your details, notes per section, an unlimited library (100 MB of files), 20 photos, 3 Smart Creation trials, an assistant (5 questions/month), 2 lifetime photo credits. PLUS (€3.99/month) adds: unlimited file storage, 200 photos, up to 10 secondary counters per section, 3 imports/month, assistant (10 questions/month), 5 photo credits/month, advanced statistics. PRO (€6.99/month) unlocks everything: 15 imports/month, assistant (30 questions/month), 20 photo credits/month.

You import a pattern as a PDF or paste a URL — YarnFlow analyses the document, detects the sections (back, front, sleeves...), extracts the technical details (yarn, needles, gauge) and creates your project automatically. It's also what activates the contextual assistant on this project: it then knows the exact text of your pattern, not just its structure. 3 free trials for everyone, then 3 imports/month on PLUS or 15 imports/month on PRO.

items.q: Which devices does it work on?
items.a: YarnFlow is a PWA — available in every browser (mobile, tablet, computer). You can install it on your phone like a real app, with an icon on your home screen. No App Store download required.
Yes, with no commitment. You cancel from your profile, your subscription stays active until the end of the paid period, then you automatically return to FREE. Your data is kept.

items.q: Are my patterns and projects safe?
items.a: Your data is stored securely on our servers, is never shared or sold, and you can delete it at any time.
